tasks.subject: Task 1: FolderPath value object
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Implement the provider-neutral `FolderPath` value object (parse/join/parent/depth/name) with the canonical `/` separator, exactly per CONTRACTS.md §1.

**Files:**
Create: src/EMaigrator.Core/Model/FolderPath.cs
Test: src/EMaigrator.Core.Tests/Model/FolderPathTests.cs

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- FolderPath(IReadOnlyList<string> segments) stores a defensive copy; Segments is read-only.
- Depth == Segments.Count; Name == Segments[^1] (or "" when root); IsRoot == (Segments.Count == 0).
- Parse("A/B/C") yields 3 segments; Parse("A|B", '|') honors the custom separator; empty/whitespace-only segments dropped; leading/trailing separators trimmed.
- ToString() joins with /; ToString('|') joins with the supplied char.
- Parent() returns path minus last segment; Parent() on root throws InvalidOperationException.
- Value equality holds.

**Verify:** `dotnet test src/EMaigrator.Core.Tests --filter FullyQualifiedName~FolderPathTests` -> all pass.

tasks.subject: Task 3: IdentityKey.Compute — Message-ID primary + composite SHA-256 fallback
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Implement `IdentityKey.Compute(MessageIdentityInput)` returning "mid:<normalized-message-id>" when a Message-ID is present, else "h:<sha256hex>" over normalized From|To|Subject|Date|<decoded-body-sha256>, never hashing raw transport bytes, deterministic and case/whitespace-normalized.

**Files:**
Create: src/EMaigrator.Core/Idempotency/MessageIdentityInput.cs
Create: src/EMaigrator.Core/Idempotency/IdentityKey.cs
Test: src/EMaigrator.Core.Tests/Idempotency/IdentityKeyTests.cs

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Non-empty MessageId -> "mid:"+normalized id (trim, lowercase, strip one angle-bracket pair, collapse/trim inner whitespace).
- Null/blank MessageId -> "h:"+lowercase 64-char sha256 hex over canonical from|to|subject|date|bodyHash (addresses lowercased, date ISO-8601 UTC).
- Compute is deterministic: same input -> same output.
- Inputs differing only in DecodedBodySha256Hex differ; identical inputs match.
- Fallback never incorporates raw transport bytes — only DecodedBodySha256Hex + normalized fields (property test: distinct raw forms, identical decoded-body hash -> identical key).
- DecodedBodySha256Hex is required; null MessageIdentityInput throws ArgumentNullException.

**Verify:** `dotnet test src/EMaigrator.Core.Tests --filter FullyQualifiedName~IdentityKeyTests` -> all pass.

tasks.subject: Task 8: FolderSanitizer.Sanitize
tasks.description:

**Files:**

Test: src/EMaigrator.Core.Tests/Diagnostics/FolderSanitizerTests.cs

**Acceptance Criteria:**

- A segment matching a ReservedFolderNames entry (case-insensitive) is suffixed with _.

- Default (permissive) constraints leave the path unchanged.

tasks.subject: Task 9: FolderFlattener.Flatten
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Implement FolderFlattener.Flatten(FolderPath, int maxDepth, char joinChar = '-') (pure) that collapses any segments beyond maxDepth into the last kept segment joined by joinChar — table-driven tests for depth-overflow and no-op cases plus collision context.

**Files:**
Create: src/EMaigrator.Core/Diagnostics/FolderFlattener.cs
Test: src/EMaigrator.Core.Tests/Diagnostics/FolderFlattenerTests.cs

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Path with depth <= maxDepth returned unchanged.
- Path with depth > maxDepth keeps first maxDepth-1 segments and joins the remaining tail with joinChar into the final segment (/A/B/C/D/E maxDepth=1 -> A-B-C-D-E; maxDepth=3 -> A/B/C-D-E).
- joinChar honored (custom char e.g. _).
- maxDepth <= 0 throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException.
- Deterministic: equal input -> equal output (collision resolution is the caller/sanitizer's job).
- Pure: input unchanged.

**Verify:** `dotnet test src/EMaigrator.Core.Tests --filter FullyQualifiedName~FolderFlattenerTests` -> all pass.

tasks.subject: Task 10: ErrorCatalog implementation + rule matching
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Implement a concrete ErrorCatalog : IErrorCatalog that matches a normalized error signature against an ordered rule set via case-insensitive regex, with provider-specific rules overriding Provider==null rules, returning an ErrorResolution whose Suggestion/Diagnosis come verbatim from the rule and never echo the signature.

**Files:**

Test: src/EMaigrator.Core.Tests/Diagnostics/ErrorCatalogTests.cs

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- ErrorCatalog(IReadOnlyList<ErrorRule>) matches the first rule whose SignatureRegex matches (case-insensitive); provider-specific rules evaluated before provider-agnostic.
- Non-matching signature returns null.
- Match returns ErrorResolution carrying the rule's Diagnosis/Suggestion/Kind/RecommendedAction/Options/Severity verbatim.
- A rule with invalid regex is rejected at construction time with ArgumentException (fail fast).
- Returned Diagnosis/Suggestion never interpolate the matched signature text (proven by feeding a signature with arbitrary text).

tasks.subject: Task 12: PreflightAnalyzer implementation
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Implement a concrete PreflightAnalyzer : IPreflightAnalyzer that scans source folders against the destination's ProviderConstraints, emits PreflightIssues for depth/illegal-char/path-length violations (with the recommended structural action), applies include/exclude folder filters, and computes a MigrationEstimate over the scoped folders — using only in-memory provider fakes (no I/O of its own).

**Files:**
Create: src/EMaigrator.Core/Preflight/PreflightAnalyzer.cs
Test: src/EMaigrator.Core.Tests/Preflight/PreflightAnalyzerTests.cs

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Enumerates source.ListFoldersAsync, applies IncludeFolders/ExcludeFolders (case-insensitive; null include = all), computes MigrationEstimate (MailboxCount=max(1,Pairs.Count), FolderCount, MessageCount summed, TotalBytes via average heuristic, EstimatedDuration via throughput constant).

tasks.subject: Task 16: Security Verification — identity hash is a fingerprint; error catalog never echoes credentials
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Prove the two security properties for this subsystem: (1) the identity hash is a deterministic content fingerprint that reveals no secret and never incorporates raw bytes; (2) the error catalog's diagnoses/suggestions never echo a credential value embedded in an error signature — with captured test output.

**USER-ORDERED GATE — NON-SKIPPABLE.** This task was requested by the user in the current conversation. It MUST NOT be closed by walking around it, by declaring it "verified inline", or by substituting a cheaper check. Close only after every item in acceptanceCriteria has been re-validated independently, with output captured.

**Files:**
Create: src/EMaigrator.Core.Tests/Security/IdentityAndCatalogSecurityTests.cs

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- dotnet test --filter IdentityAndCatalogSecurityTests passes and its captured console output is recorded in the task close note.
- Identity-hash deterministic: two Compute calls with identical input produce byte-identical output (captured output shows the same h: hash twice).
- Identity-hash reveals no secret: input embedding literal password P@ssw0rd-LEAK in From/Subject/DecodedBodySha256Hex produces an h:-prefixed 64-hex key that does NOT contain the substring P@ssw0rd-LEAK.
- No-raw-bytes: two inputs with identical normalized fields + identical DecodedBodySha256Hex but different raw transit forms yield the identical key.
- Error catalog never echoes credentials: a rule matched against a signature containing password=Sup3r$ecret123 and Bearer eyJhbGciOi.LEAKED.TOKEN returns Diagnosis/Suggestion containing neither secret (equal to the rule's static text).
- A grep-style regex assertion over the serialized resolution confirms zero occurrences of either secret token.
- The Message-ID path also never echoes a secret: mid: output contains only the normalized id, no body/secret fields.

**Verify:** `dotnet test src/EMaigrator.Core.Tests --filter FullyQualifiedName~IdentityAndCatalogSecurityTests --logger "console;verbosity=detailed"` -> all pass; capture the output block.
